Subject: Request: repackage SOW line-items + align price bands (Aurora)

Vanessa —

Thanks again for walking through the implementation assumptions yesterday. Aurora Finance completed an internal scrub of the draft order form and we have two related asks that need to be addressed in an amendment/change order before we can route for our CFO approval: 

1) Repackaging of SOW line-items: combine "Inference Reserved Capacity" and "Burst Capacity" into a single throughput SKU with per-token floor/ceiling definitions. This will simplify our internal chargeback.

2) Price-band alignment: because the expected monthly token consumption cross the tiers you provided, we need clearer per-token price bands for 0-1B, 1B-5B, 5B+ and a mechanism for retroactive true-up for the quarter.

I attached a short change request (Aurora-Change-Request-v1.pdf) that highlights the sections we'd like redlined. Can your team confirm: (a) whether these changes require a formal MSA amendment vs. order form change order, and (b) an estimated impact to the committed monthly fee if we move to the consolidated SKU?

Time is tight — can we aim to get a draft redline by EOD Friday so finance can start routing approvals? Happy to set a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Sara

- Draft redline: we'll produce an Order Form change order redline (showing line-item consolidation + proposed price bands + retroactive true-up clause) and share for your review. If Laura deems we need an MSA clause tweak we'll include that as a separate doc.

Vanessa / Sara — following our pricing review I ran two quick models. High level: consolidating the two line items into a single throughput SKU reduces administrative complexity and can produce a modest discount in the mid-tier usage band due to reduced per-SKU overhead. Attached are the illustrative bands I recommend for the change order. 

Suggested bands (illustrative):
- 0–1B tokens: $0.0016 / token
- 1B–5B tokens: $0.0012 / token
- 5B+ tokens: $0.0009 / token

Quarterly retroactive true-up approach: compute actual quarter consumption, apply blended effective rate vs invoiced amounts; invoice credit or invoice balance as appropriate. We should cap retroactive exposure to a single quarter (no more than 1 quarter back).

Legal note: if Aurora requires retroactive credits beyond a single quarter or dynamic per-request metering changes we will need a short MSA amendment that clarifies billing reconciliation and audit rights. Laura — tagging you here for a quick review of the retroactive cap and audit language.

Sara — I attached the pricing model (spreadsheet referenced inline) and will fold these numbers into Vanessa's redline. Any crystal-clear must-haves from Aurora's side that would change the bands? (e.g., guaranteed minimum monthly committed throughput, or requirement for invoice smoothing).

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Karthik / Sara — quick legal read below after reviewing the proposed approach and the attached change request. I added a tracked redline (redlines-msa.docx) with three calls-to-action: 

1) Keep the Order Form change order as the primary execution, but include an explicit cross-reference clause in the MSA that makes the billing/true-up mechanism effective. That preserves the MSA's integrity while keeping the commercial change localized.

2) Retroactive true-up: we can accept a single-quarter true-up with a maximum cap equal to 25% of the invoiced quarter amount. That cap limits Redwood exposure; if Aurora requires a higher cap please flag now for exec review.

3) Audit rights: limit Aurora audit to quarterly billing records and require at least 30 days notice. Any additional audit scope will need an MSA amendment.

Please review the doc I attached and confirm: (a) Aurora agrees to the 25% cap, (b) who will be signatory on the change order, and (c) whether you want the change documented as an Order Form amendment (preferred) or an MSA amendment (less preferred). Once we have agreement we'll produce a clean change order + signature pages for DocuSign.
